title: Emitting Transition That Halts
statement: Let $M$ be an $m$-tape Turing machine over Boolean symbols with state set $S$, and let $c$ be a configuration on a Boolean input word $y$. Suppose $c$ is in state $q$, the Boolean tag $b$ satisfies the boundary condition for its input-head position, and the transition of $M$ from $q$ on the symbols currently read halts while emitting the bit $a$. For any Boolean input word $x$, any virtual input-head position $p$ among the $|x|+2$ positions, and any Boolean list $\mathrm{pre}$, one step of the virtual simulation from the configuration built from $c,b,p,\mathrm{pre}$ has no state and has output $\mathrm{pre}$ followed by the output of $c$ and then $a$.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ is a natural number and $S$ is a type
$M$ is an $m$-tape machine over Boolean symbols with states in $S$
$y$ is a Boolean list and $c$ is a configuration on input $y$
$b$ is a Boolean tag satisfying the boundary condition for $c$'s input-head position
$p$ is a position among the $|x|+2$ virtual input-head positions
$q$ is a state with $c$ in state $q$
the transition from $q$ on the currently read symbols halts
that transition emits a Boolean bit $a$
